description: Three of the five icon-only controls on Sales By Representative give a screen reader a name that is not the one written down. The three-dot download button announces "Export report" instead of "Report actions"; the column button announces "Column Selection" instead of "Show or hide columns"; and the chevron at the top of the table announces "Expand all representatives" and "Collapse all representatives" instead of "Expand all reps" and "Collapse all reps".
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-7168d14. Desktop browser, signed in as an Admin.
steps: Open Reports, then Sales By Representative.
With a screen reader or an accessibility inspector, read the name of the three-dot download button, then the column button.

Read the name of the chevron at the top of the table, both before and after using it. The named test data: sales representatives ZZAUTOTEST RepA (one invoice, S-16244) and ZZAUTOTEST RepB (three invoices, S-16243, S-16242, S-16241), plus Parth Fadadu (one invoice, S-15826); customers Aaborough Works, Aacastle Services, Aachester Partners, Aacrest Works and Beman Systems; both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
current:
The three names above are what the controls announce. Every control works, and a screen-reader user is told something sensible — just not the agreed wording, so it does not match the rest of the suite.

All five were checked. The per-row chevrons are correct: they announce "Expand ZZAUTOTEST RepA" and change to "Collapse ZZAUTOTEST RepA". The controls are properly keyboard operable, so this is the name only.
expected: Each control announces the name the description gives it, word for word: "Report actions", "Show or hide columns", and "Expand all reps" / "Collapse all reps".
source: Every icon-only control has an accessible name ... exports = "Report actions"; column selector = "Show or hide columns"; per-row chevron = "Expand {rep name}" / "Collapse {rep name}"; header chevron = "Expand all reps" / "Collapse all reps"; dialog X = "Close".
